task.objective: TARGETED MEDIA CORPS VERIFICATION. Inspect the free media commander and integration bridge together with the route config and tests. Determine whether any installed/approved Fal, Runway, or paid Google generation route can become the selected generation path when the free mesh is unavailable; whether paid_media_approved can leak into generation through the legacy mission; whether Google analysis can accidentally become generation; and whether publication can bypass rights/metadata/connection/human approval. Separately audit free_media_evidence trust: identify whether plain booleans without source, observed_at/freshness, route/model binding, or evidence provenance can make a stale/spoofed route READY. Distinguish repository-controlled config misconfiguration from runtime evidence bypass. Return only confirmed findings, false positives, smallest safe patch, and deterministic tests. Do not recommend paid fallback or production activation.
